review.notes: "The Council" correctly takes the capitalized-common-noun default (typed, no Name atom), and the possession verb takes Holder/Theme with the counted group riding the object; bare present correctly gets no status atom.

Bare-plural verbal generic as a 0.9/0.9 distributing rule with a Skolem event, no QuantifierPhrase (no quantifier word), compound kind council_member with genus member and the noun modifier unexposed, and 'permanently' in the surface-form Duration slot rather than Manner all follow the instruction set. Fusing 'council member' rather than routing it through PartOf as a group member is the one boundary the compound-vs-part test leaves close, but the generic subject needs a kind symbol, so the fusion reads as licensed.
